answer: Give every agent a public work thread: a chained record of completed jobs, payments, and peer ratings. New identities start at the bottom of a trust canyon, capped to tiny transactions until their thread proves consistent, useful behavior over weeks. Reputation accrues like a glacier, slow and hard to fake, and bad behavior burns the whole history. Spinning up ten thousand Sybils then costs ten thousand slow, expensive climbs out of the canyon, while one honest agent record compounds.
